metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Nocturne
metas.description: Ex-soldier Jonah Lynn leaves Philadelphia for a quiet life. When serial killer Jurek Walter threatens his new home and family, Jonah must protect them, even as he sends his FBI agent daughter Saga to track the killer's last victim.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2018 · 100 Days My Prince
metas.description: Upon losing his memory, a crown prince encounters a commoner's life and experiences unforgettable love as the husband to Joseon's oldest bachelorette.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · Dead-End Job
metas.description: When a man in his 30s, Byeon Hyeok Jun, trying to escape the quagmire of debt and starts a super high-value but secretive part-time job leading to an unfolding of unexpected events.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2016 · Orange
metas.description: High school student Naho Takamiya receives a letter from her future self that warns her to avoid mistakes she will make involving a new transfer student, Kakeru Naruse, a troubled boy whom she meets and begins to fall in love with.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2014 · Surviving Jack
metas.description: A boy becomes a man, and a man becomes a father, in a time before coming of age was something you could Google.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2009 · Fighting Spirit: New Challenger
metas.description: Ippo continues to defend his title and training to reach his goal, Ichiro Miyata. While Takamura goes for the world, and faces the world champion, Brian Hawk. In what is to become his toughest fight so far.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Eternally Yours
metas.description: Follows the journey of a married vampire couple struggling to accept their daughter's human boyfriend, after being together for 500 years.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2022 · Signora Volpe
metas.description: Sylvia, a disillusioned British spy turned detective starts a new life in the beautiful heart of Italy. She soon finds out trouble follows her wherever she goes.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Lynley
metas.description: DI Thomas Lynley and DS Barbara Havers form an unlikely police detective duo. Their contrasting backgrounds create tension, but they unite to solve crimes, navigating class and gender issues.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2015 · The Great Pottery Throw Down
metas.description: Ten home potters from around the country head to Stoke-on-Trent, the home of pottery, in their quest to become Top Potter.
